name: TARS Autonomous Trader
description: Autonomous portfolio risk copilot and trading agent. Audits holdings, scores risk, and enforces non-overridable risk gates before any order; every decision is written to an onchain audit trail.

service.name: TARS Portfolio Risk Audit
service.description: Runs a comprehensive portfolio audit over data the caller forwards: scores concentration, leverage and position risk, applies the same non-overridable risk gates used before live orders, and returns a structured report plus a markdown summary. No server-side credentials required in data-forwarding mode. Hire it via POST /hire.

parameters: mode (string, optional): 'own_account' (default) audits the data you forward; 'demo' / 'live' are shorthands for profile_mode. Unknown values are rejected with 422.
profile_mode (string, optional): 'demo' (default) or 'live'. 'live' requires ALLOW_LIVE=true on the deployment.
inst_type (string, optional): 'SWAP', 'FUTURES' or 'OPTION' — limits the leverage/positions check to that instrument type.

balance_data (object, required for data-forwarding): output of `okx account balance-all --json`. The {'data': [...]} envelope is accepted, as is a single account row {'trading': {...}}. balance_data.trading.totalEq is required.
positions_data (array or object, optional): output of `okx account positions --json` — either the array of positions or the {'data': [...]} envelope.

response.description: Audit report: risk score, flags with severity, markdown summary, and needs_human_review. Returned synchronously.

payment.posture: Launch-free: priced routes answer without payment until the operator configures PAY_TO_ADDRESS. /api/v1/pricing, /api/v1/estimate and /.well-known/x402 always report the exact enforcement state.

risk_disclosure: Paper-trading agent. The live gate is closed (ALLOW_LIVE=false) and the G1 paper milestone is not met, so no live track record exists or is claimed. Audits and risk gates are real; trade execution is not live.
